description: Search the product catalogue, find low-stock products and record stock movements in the Product Management API.
name: product-management/mcp

environmentVariables.name: ProductApi__BaseUrl
environmentVariables.description: Gateway URL of the Product Management API

environmentVariables.name: ProductApi__ClientId
environmentVariables.description: API consumer id of the MCP server

environmentVariables.name: ProductApi__LowStockThreshold
environmentVariables.description: Stock at or below which list_low_stock reports a product (default 10)

environmentVariables.name: ProductApi__ClientSecret
environmentVariables.description: API consumer secret of the MCP server
